name: llm-data-guard-pii-secrets
title: LLM Data Guard: PII & Secret Redactor
description: Detect and redact PII (emails, phones, SSNs, Luhn-checked cards, IBANs, IPs, optional names/addresses) and secrets (API keys, tokens, private keys, high-entropy strings) in text, HTML or PDF before it reaches an LLM. Placeholder, mask or hash redaction with reversible map. No data retention.
